ValidationRule.description: Payment should be completed before the pre invoice stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
$RecordType.DeveloperName = "Vehicle",
NOT(ISPICKVAL(Payment_Status__c , "Completed")),
OR(
ISPICKVAL(Status, "Pre Invoice"),
ISPICKVAL(Status, "RTO Registration"),
ISPICKVAL(Status, "Ready For Delivery"),
ISPICKVAL(Status, "Vehicle Delivered")
)
)
